question: After removing density range, contrast magnitude and global exposure shift, do Kodak's TRI-X 400 D-76 curves at 6, 8, 10 and 12 minutes retain material toe/shoulder shape differences that a contrast-index-only process profile cannot represent?

source_graph.process: Large Tank; agitation at 1 minute intervals; 20 C

analysis.normalization: per-curve observed density endpoints to zero-one; invert normalized density to log exposure; subtract each signature mean
analysis.uncertainty: independent plus/minus 3px uncertainty at every inverse-density query; horizontal error plus a conservative normalized-density error covering the query and both endpoint measurements, converted through the worst local inverse slope

forbidden: interpret graph traces as roll calibration
change density levels, path identities or gates after scoring
claim P2AE CI-only profiles are complete if shape difference passes

branch_rule.pass: mark CI-only process profiles incomplete and require time-conditioned characteristic shape in any future B&W profile
branch_rule.fail: do not establish time-conditioned toe or shoulder shape from this graph; retain P2AE only as a limited CI interpolation, not a complete process model

claim_ceiling: First-party TRI-X 400 / D-76 characteristic-shape source evidence after nuisance normalization; not roll calibration, developer chemistry model, grain/MTF/scanner or photographic appearance.
